task.description: Translate the listed Sai files from Russian into English, following decisions/0080-english-instructions.md exactly (read it first, including the glossary in item 5). Rules: (1) the meaning must not change — same rules, numbers, names, order of sections; do not shorten, improve or add rules; (2) keep unchanged every file name, identifier, field name, AP-NNN, REQ-NNN, ISS-NNNN, decision number, command, role code and code block; (3) the front matter keys stay, but name: and description: are written in English (the name keeps the form "Sai <Role> (CODE)"); (4) text that the owner or a customer reads and tool error messages stay in the original Russian when quoted, followed by a short English gloss in parentheses; (5) plain, short English sentences, one term per concept (use the glossary); (6) no computer paths and no names of other projects in the text; (7) write the file in place with the Write tool, do not run prettier on .md outside tools/. Do not use git checkout/reset/stash/clean and do not commit. Do not stop the demo server on port 4782. Before close run: cd tools && npm run handoffs-check and npm run traces. In result list the files you translated and anything you were unsure about (issues). Files to translate: docs/quality-bar.md, docs/anti-patterns.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md, tools/README.md. Also merge README.en.md into README.md and docs/agents.en.md into the matching role files only where English text adds something the translation does not have; then delete README.en.md and docs/agents.en.md with rm (they are untracked-copy files of the same content) and fix links to them everywhere in docs/ and README.md.

result.summary: Translated from Russian into English, in place, under decisions/0080: docs/quality-bar.md, docs/anti-patterns.md (all 123 records AP-001..AP-123 kept in order, with their numbers), CLAUDE.md, README.md and tools/README.md (then formatted with prettier). Same sections in the same order, same rules and numbers; file names, identifiers, commands and code blocks are unchanged; words the page shows and tool messages are quoted in Russian with an English gloss. README.en.md was merged into README.md (the roles/handoffs/gates/workflows part, the detailed list of what works, the real-run note and the newer "not ready" section) and removed with rm; docs/agents.en.md was removed (its general part is in README.md, its per-role part duplicated the role files, which are other agents' files). No rule was added, removed or shortened.

Facts for that step: the README headings are now "How to open on another computer" and "Check on GitHub and before a push" (in this order, nothing between them); the words of the GitHub section are now in English: "no branch protection", "the merge is confirmed by the owner", "about 2 minutes", "bypass", "working folder" (the other eleven of the thirteen words are unchanged; the section has none of "private", "public", "403"); tools/README.md headings were translated (13 "## " and 58 "### " headings, same count and order), and quoted screen words such as «нет свежих данных», «сервер перезапускался», «строка на агента» stay in Russian inside quotes, with an English gloss next to them. HO-46 and HO-47 also failed in my run; they run other test files and are probably affected by edits of other agents, I did not check.

Russian kept on purpose (decision 0080 items 3 and 4): in tools/README.md the words the page shows, tool error messages, help and output lines are quoted in Russian with a short English gloss; code blocks (commands and their output) are unchanged, so placeholders inside code blocks stay Russian (for example <ШАГ>, <папка>) with a gloss under the block, while placeholders in inline code in the prose were written in English (<port>, <number>). In docs/anti-patterns.md the four field names of a record (Что случилось, Почему это плохо, Как правильно, Где найдено) stay in Russian, as the role file doc-updater.md quotes them; the format block keeps them and a sentence under it gives their meaning. Quoted Russian words in records (for example «рано», «да», «нет свежих данных») are kept with a gloss. References to section names of handoffs.md and the workflows were aligned with the English headings that exist now ("Pauses and interruptions", "Bookkeeping check", "Who writes what", "How ORCH writes the task", "Where handoffs are stored and how they are named", "Variant: a short document with a value gate", "The \"before\" snapshot and parallel runs", "Short path", "Report to the owner"); if other translators rename those headings, these references must be aligned.
